problem.label: Life doesn't come with a script
problem.p1: The other person asks the one question that matters. Or they speak fast, in a second language, and you lose the thread. For a few seconds you freeze. Tonvo is there for those seconds.

solution.heading1: A calm voice on your side.
solution.desc: Tonvo follows the conversation as it happens. It shows what the other person just asked, a short read on the moment, and three replies you can use. You decide what to say. Tonvo makes sure you never run out of words.

solution.step2Desc: Three replies and a quick read on the moment, as the conversation unfolds. Live translation on paid plans.
solution.step3Desc: After the conversation, get a summary, what went well, and the next steps to follow up on.

faq.title: Questions people ask.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your first session with Tonvo.
faq.a1: Tonvo is a copilot for live conversations. It listens, transcribes, and puts three ready replies and a short read on the moment on your screen. You stay in charge of what you say.
faq.q2: What can I use it for?
faq.a2: Calls and meetings, interviews, negotiations, and conversations in another language. You can also paste a message or upload screenshots to get help with how to answer.
faq.q3: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a3: Tonvo runs in the browser on computers, phones and tablets. On a phone it listens through the microphone, so put your call on speaker. It cannot capture the other side of a phone call on its own, and it does not listen in the background.
faq.a4: The app and the replies work in 10 languages, and Tonvo can detect the language of the conversation. Live translation is available on the paid plans.
faq.q5: Can the other person see Tonvo?
faq.a5: On Plus and Team, Tonvo opens in its own window, which a shared tab or window does not include. On the Free plan the replies appear in the page itself, so keep that page out of what you share. If you share your entire screen, others can see Tonvo. You should always tell the people you talk to when you use a tool like this, and follow the rules that apply to you.
faq.a6: Audio is not stored by Tonvo and screen captures are not kept. We keep the text of your sessions and your reports so you can read them again. See our Privacy Policy for the details and the services involved.
faq.a7: Start free, no credit card. Paid plans come with a 7-day money-back guarantee.

privacyPage.analyticsText: We measure how visitors use tonvo.co with our own first-party tool, without any third-party service: page views, clicks on sign-up buttons, sign-ups, first live session and payments. It stores a random visitor ID in your browser for up to 13 months, plus the page, how you arrived (for example a campaign link), your country and your device type. No IP address, no email, no third-party tracker. The data is kept in our own database (Supabase, see section 6) and deleted after 25 months. We honour Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track, and you can turn measurement off below at any time.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1Intro: The data controller for the Tonvo application is:
privacyPage.s2Intro: We collect the following categories of data:
privacyPage.s2AccountDesc: Email address, display name, authentication provider (Google or email/password), account creation date.
privacyPage.s2SessionDesc: Conversation transcriptions, tone analysis results, AI-generated suggestions, conversation scores, insights, and classification.
privacyPage.s2ScreenDesc: When you share your screen, Tonvo captures frames for visual analysis. Frames are processed in real-time and are NOT permanently stored on our servers. Only the analysis results (text-based context, mood, insights) are saved.
privacyPage.s2AudioDesc: Audio chunks are transmitted to our servers for transcription, then immediately discarded after processing. Only the resulting text transcription is stored as part of session data.
privacyPage.s2PaymentDesc: Subscription plan, payment status, and billing period. Payment processing is handled by Stripe — we do not store credit card numbers.

privacyPage.s3Item6: To ensure the security and integrity of our platform.

aboutPage.title: I built Tonvo for the moment your mind goes blank.
aboutPage.intro: Hi, I'm Emilien Nepveu, a software engineer based in France and the founder of Tonvo. Here is why it exists.
aboutPage.s1p1: I kept noticing the same moment, on sales calls, in job interviews, in everyday conversations. Things are going well. Then the other person asks the one question that matters: the price, the competitor, the "why should we trust you?". And for a few seconds, your mind goes blank.
aboutPage.s1p2: The right answer always comes. Just too late: in the car, in the shower, an hour after you hang up.
aboutPage.quote: The French even have a name for it: l'esprit de l'escalier, the perfect reply you only find on your way down the stairs.
aboutPage.s2p1: Nobody remembers those few seconds. But they quietly decide what happens next: the follow-up that never comes, the discount you didn't need to give, the "let me think about it" that turns into nothing.
aboutPage.s2p2: Most call tools focus on what happens after the call: recordings, summaries, notes. Useful, but by then the moment is gone.
aboutPage.s3p1: Tonvo helps during the call, not after. It listens from your side, so no bot joins the meeting. When the other person asks a question, Tonvo pins it on your screen and puts three ready answers right under it, in seconds.
aboutPage.s3p2: You stay in the conversation, in your own words. You just never face the blank alone again.
aboutPage.p1Text: Tonvo runs on your side. Nobody sees an extra participant join.
aboutPage.p2Title: Tonvo does not store your audio.
aboutPage.p2Text: It is turned into text in real time: we keep the text of your sessions, never the recording.
aboutPage.p3Text: You won't find invented user counts or made-up reviews from me. When there are real results, I'll show them.
aboutPage.p4Text: Try it on your next real call: 3 live sessions a month, free. Decide after.
aboutPage.p5Text: Questions, ideas, a call that went sideways? Write to me directly:
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Next time someone asks about the price, you won't be alone with the silence.
